description: One call from a file to structured JSON: uploads a local file or URL (or reuses a document_id), runs a DocuPipe extraction, waits and returns the extracted data. Pass schema_id to reuse a saved schema, json_schema to define the fields inline, or neither to let DocuPipe draft a schema from the document (its schemaId comes back so later calls give the same fields). If it returns status 'processing', call the tool in 'next' to resume; it never uploads or extracts twice. Credits: upload 1/page for PDF, image, Word and HTML (CSV, Excel, JSON, text and XML upload free); extraction 2/page at standard effort, 4/page at high effort, 3/page with citations (always standard effort). Without a schema, drafting one costs 1 credit per page on at most the first 5 pages. Creating a schema from json_schema is free.

citations.description: Cite every value to its place on the page (bounding box and confidence). Runs at standard effort, 3 credits/page.

document_id.description: An already uploaded document, instead of uploading again.

effort_level.description: Extraction effort. 'standard' (default) is right for most documents; use 'high' only after standard missed or misread values.

file_path.description: Local file to upload, relative to the working directory.

guidelines.description: Plain-language extraction instructions. Without a schema they also steer the drafted schema.

include_field_metadata.description: Also return per-field page numbers and, with citations, boxes and confidence.

json_schema.description: Inline JSON Schema (type object, properties with a description each). Saved as a new schema first, free.

save_to.description: Optional path to write the extracted JSON to, relative to the working directory.

schema_name.description: Name for the schema created from json_schema.

standardization_id.description: Resume: an extraction already started. Requires standardization_job_id.

upload_job_id.description: The upload job of document_id, when resuming.

url.description: Public URL of the file to upload, instead of file_path.

name: extract
title: Extract data from a document
